## Scope

The local first-row source is JP S(Nraw), with Nraw the unnormalized numerator. No extra division by mu or inverse Fourier frequency is inserted. The nine full old-circle nonlocal terms and the five independent even-mean terms remain. The full65 centre, full193 direction, all1079 original physical seams and the653 previously recorded normalized seam rows retain their identity.

These are source bounds for the same actual first correction. They do not prove the complete corrected-seam operator, a strong return bound, the cutoff97 inverse, the unknown high-frequency feedback, or an exact PDE branch. Failed old large-radius bounds remain historical evidence; no old upper is removed by subtracting another upper.

The original78 accepted stages and old complete norm tables are immutable historical inputs. New native/stage/case files stay in the temporary runner and are not uploaded to main, a Release or an Actions artifact. This conclusion records only script, parameters, actual run, numerical conclusions and identities.
